prompt: Award-winning luxury commercial product photography of a premium skincare serum bottle. Centered on a clean, solid pure white reflective pedestal with subtle soft gradient reflections. The bottle is crafted from heavy translucent frosted glass with dewy crystal clarity, showing amber liquid inside, topped with a brushed champagne-gold metallic dropper cap with fine micro-grooves. Shot on Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, 100mm macro lens, f/8 for tack-sharp product details. Overhead massive softbox lighting creating a silky smooth white gradient reflection along the glass curvature, subtle warm rim light emphasizing the bottle silhouette, pristine high-end Vogue cosmetics advertising aesthetic, clean studio lighting.
